summary: Three frozen v2 expectations placed a natural-language label inside parentheses after the candidate. pii-context/v1 splits tokens only on whitespace, underscore, hyphen, colon and equals, and the family contracts require a whole label, so a parenthesized label is not an associated label. The frozen plans are unchanged; these corrections are applied only to the corrected accounting view.

corrections.contractBasis: pii-context/v1 normalization.tokenSeparators excludes parentheses; us-ssn-v1 lets only an associated whole example/documentation label win after positive context, so the ssn field label stands.
pii-context/v1 normalization.tokenSeparators excludes parentheses, so a parenthesized contact details phrase is not the high-signal natural-language label and no other context is associated.
pii-context/v1 normalization.tokenSeparators excludes parentheses; phone-v1 names ko-example-label as an occurrence exclusion only when associated, so the 전화번호 field label stands.
